driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's count of an outcome found only by linking its records to an outside register, where the linker misses true outcomes for records with weak identifiers and invents false ones for records with common identifiers, at rates measurable only on two internal control groups (outcomes the units' own later records show, and records shown still active after a linked outcome); a unit whose weak-identifier records are low-risk is inflated by false links and one whose weak-identifier records are high-risk is deflated by missed links, so counting the links, adding the outcomes known from the records, or dropping the links the records contradict each leaves one of them on the wrong side of the threshold.
driver_concrete: Each hospital's 30-day deaths for its fiscal 2026 Medicaid index admissions are the deaths in hospital plus the post-discharge deaths the linkage found, corrected class by class (Social Security number on file or not, compound surname or not) for the false links measured on members with claims after their linked death and for the missed links measured on members whose death a later inpatient claim records; an obstetrics hospital whose emergency-Medicaid mothers carry common surnames loses its add-on on false links, and a dialysis hospital whose emergency-dialysis patients carry compound surnames keeps it on missed ones, until both are corrected.
stump: The default path counts each hospital's in-hospital deaths and linked post-discharge deaths, adds the deaths later inpatient claims record and drops the links later claims contradict, and takes the add-on from the obstetrics hospital while the dialysis hospital keeps it; corrected for the linkage's false links and missed links class by class, the obstetrics hospital keeps it and the dialysis hospital loses it.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the fee-for-service claims and both plans' encounters into index admissions, applies the measure's index and exclusion rules and counts deaths from the hospital disposition and the death linkage (adding the deaths later claims record, dropping the links later claims contradict) files the obstetrics hospital as losing the add-on and the dialysis hospital as keeping it; corrected for the linkage's error rates measured on the two control groups, the sets reverse.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each hospital's risk-adjusted 30-day mortality ratio, observed over expected, with deaths after discharge ascertained by probabilistic linkage to vital records, as health services research measures it, and the field corrects linked outcomes for linkage error; with schools in place of hospitals there is no risk-adjusted mortality, no emergency Medicaid without a Social Security number and no death file, so the task does not survive the swap.

differentiation.task98: task98 v6 counts units under a score threshold whose closed periods were scored on a classifier the improvement programme could not move; here no classifier changes: the forward quantity is each group spend developed by how long its active units have been active, read from every unit that has passed each duration.
differentiation.task468: v1 weighted a clustered review of unmatched transit events to allocate them; v2 and v3 projected pharmacy spend by a duration clock; v4 corrects an outcome count found through a probabilistic linkage for the linkage's own false and missed links, measured on two control groups inside the record, a different quantity, source and correction.
differentiation.task126: task126 v1 splits units a succession link wrongly joins, read off a separate credit ledger; here no unit is split or joined: an outcome count is corrected for a probabilistic linkage's false and missed links, at rates measured on two control groups inside the claims.
differentiation.task450: task450 v1 weights a scheduled visit's sightings by whether the visit ended the event it saw; here nothing is sampled by visits: every member is linked, and the correction removes false links and restores missed ones by identifier class.
differentiation.task469: task469 reads a share observed only where an allowance was already short, a censoring correction; here the outcome is fully observable in principle and the error is the linker's, false links inflating low-risk weak-identifier members and missed links deflating high-risk ones.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a per-unit count assembled from records that a matcher links to units, where the matcher fails far more often for some units' records, so the unlinked records are not distributed like the linked ones, and the review that measures their mix draws clusters at random and one record within each, so a cluster holding many unlinked records is seen no more often than one holding a single record; the review's raw mix, like a share-out in proportion to the linked records, understates the units whose clusters fail most, and only each reviewed record weighted by its cluster's count of unlinked records restores each unit's count.
lineage.niche: a city transit department's delivered-frequency evidence for a state capital program, built by linking vehicle-location departure records to routes through a vendor's trip matcher that leaves late-running departures unmatched, with the department's trip-matching review sample

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what the units in each group that are active today will cost over the coming year, where cost and the chance of staying active both depend on how long a unit has been active, and the groups differ in how recently their active units started; carrying the latest run-rate or trailing year forward, applying last year's active units' following-year experience, or a group's persistence curve read from each unit's start all misstate the groups whose active units are newer or older than usual, and only each group's development conditional on time since start, applied to today's units at their own durations, gets the shares right.
lineage.niche: a regional health plan's specialty pharmacy clinical program, staffing its clinical pharmacists across drug classes by the spend each class's members already on therapy will run over the program year, from two pharmacy benefit managers' claim files

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what the units in each group that are active today will cost over the coming year, where cost and the chance of staying active depend on how long the current spell of activity has run, not on how long ago the unit was first active; units returning after a lapse look long-standing by their first activity but behave like new ones, and one group's returning units surged just before the reference date, so a development by time since first activity, applying last year's active units' following year, or carrying the trailing year forward each overstates exactly the groups the returners filled.
